cuda_runtime_failure.oracle_measurement_policy: 319 committed runtime errors remain uncredited in the original 384-case oracle denominator. Any fixed-configuration recovery measurement must be separately named and preserve original errors.

limitations: Retry counts cover recorded write retries, not successful writes, unretried failures or every process session. Each event line can describe a successful or failed wrapper invocation; the log does not record its outcome.
